answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the juniper check. Bindings are kept in bridge, verified in nadir, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. That bill is paid per identity, so 123 aliases cost 225 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
